categories.question: Your rabbit's exercise area has room for one new feature. What do you add?

outcomes.name: A willow tunnel
outcomes.description: Woven brown willow-branch tunnel with rabbit ears showing at one opening

outcomes.name: A digging box
outcomes.description: Shallow untreated wooden box filled with shredded paper and a digging bunny

outcomes.name: A hay-stuffed ball
outcomes.description: Open lattice willow ball overflowing with fragrant strands of hay

outcomes.name: A low lookout platform
outcomes.description: Small sturdy wooden platform with a sitting rabbit and a short ramp
